categories.main_business_segments: Zhangjiagang Zhonghuan Hailu High-End Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of industrial metal forgings. Its products primarily serve the wind power, engineering machinery, mining machinery, and nuclear power industries. Key product categories include bearing forgings, flange forgings, gear ring forgings, and other industrial metal forgings, which are critical components in high-end equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced forging, heat treatment, machining, and non-destructive testing technologies. It has proprietary capabilities in manufacturing large, special-shaped, high-end, and large-scale industrial metal forgings, including seamless rolling technology for large forgings. Key processes include heating with natural gas furnaces, billet forming via hydraulic presses, ring rolling, heat treatment, CNC machining, and ultrasonic, magnetic particle, and penetrant flaw detection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Its main customers are leading enterprises in the wind power sector, including domestic and international wind turbine manufacturers such as Siemens, Shanghai Electric, Thyssenkrupp, Liebherr, Siemens Gamesa, Hitachi, Toshiba, and others. The company also serves clients in engineering machinery, mining machinery, nuclear power, shipbuilding, power, and petrochemical industries. The wind power industry accounts for the majority of revenue, reflecting the company's strong market position in this sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, but also has a substantial export business, with overseas sales accounting for over 60% of revenue. Its products are supplied to customers both within China and internationally, including Europe, the Americas, and Asia. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Zhangjiagang City, Jiangsu Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhangjiagang Zhonghuan Hailu operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of key industrial metal forgings that serve as critical components for downstream high-end equipment manufacturers in wind power, engineering machinery, and other sectors. It procures raw materials such as alloy steel, carbon steel, and stainless steel and delivers finished forgings to OEMs and equipment assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D to enhance product performance and expand product categories. Key R&D projects include development of large-diameter wind power gear ring forgings, ultra-large high-tube ring forgings, large flange forgings for shield machines, and automated ultrasonic phased array testing systems. It emphasizes green intelligent manufacturing, automation, and digitalization to improve production efficiency and reduce costs. The company also focuses on expanding into new markets to mitigate risks from wind power industry cyclicality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized industrial metal forgings to downstream customers. Pricing is based on raw material costs plus processing fees, adjusted for customer relationships and order specifics. The company also earns income from sales of scrap materials and other non-core business activities. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the major domestic producers of industrial metal forgings in China, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It competes with both domestic and international forging companies, including established global leaders from Germany, the US, Japan, and Russia. The company has broken some foreign monopolies in large high-end forgings and is integrated into global supply chains of multinational corporations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 579 million, a 7.36% decrease from 2023. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 153.6 million, significantly larger than the previous year’s loss. Total assets stood at around RMB 1.56 billion with net assets of RMB 886 million. The company’s revenue and profitability were impacted by intensified competition and price declines in the wind power sector, but it maintains a solid asset base and ongoing investment in production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its advanced manufacturing capabilities for large, complex, and high-performance forgings, supported by proprietary technologies and multiple patents. It offers high-quality, customized forgings that meet stringent industry standards and certifications, serving critical applications in wind power and other high-end equipment sectors. Its integrated production process from forging to precision machining and quality inspection ensures product reliability and performance, providing customers with trusted components that support their equipment’s safety and efficiency.
